column2: What each Garborg item ACTUALLY held when read live on 2026-08-24.
The local Wikidata store was downloaded before Emma made most of these items, so it
cannot answer for them, and the builder's fallback -- "not in the store, therefore
our own batch made it, therefore it has no name statements" -- is WRONG wherever she
has edited by hand. Q141152512 Eivind carries P735, P734 and P5056 that she added
herself; without this file the batch emits a second, qualified P735 beside his bare
one, which QuickStatements records as a new statement rather than merging.
`props` is every property the item carries. `langs` is every label language.
`verified` is the date the item was read, or `no` for one that was not re-read --
those fall back to the store, then to the assumption, and must not be treated as
measured.
Q467497 is a community item of ~120 properties; only the ones this programme touches
are listed, which is why its row is short. Its `mul` entry is an ALIAS, not a label.
